Water heater service & repair in Chennai

A water heater that stops heating, leaks or trips the power needs someone who understands both the plumbing and the electrical side. We install new heaters, carry out maintenance, track down heating problems and handle repairs for storage and instant water heaters.

What we help with

Installation

Water heater installation

Wall mounting, inlet and outlet connections and a test run for new storage and instant heaters.

Maintenance

Water heater maintenance

We check the heating element, thermostat, safety valve and joints, and descale the tank where hard water has built up.

Repair

Heating performance checks

We find out why the water is not hot enough, takes too long to heat or comes out too hot.

Repair

Water heater repairs

Element, thermostat, valve and leak problems. Tell us the brand, model and symptoms and we will talk you through the repair.

Common water heater problems and needs

  1. Not heating, or heating very slowly
  2. Water too hot or not hot enough
  3. Leaking from the tank, valve or pipe joints
  4. Trips the MCB or ELCB when switched on
  5. Indicator light not working
  6. A new water heater to install

Safety first. If a water heater trips the breaker, leaks near the switch or smells of burning, switch it off at the mains and do not use it until it has been checked.

Water Heaters: frequently asked questions

Do you work on instant and storage water heaters?

Yes. We work on both wall mounted storage heaters and instant heaters.

Do you install new water heaters?

Yes. Tell us the model and where it will be fitted, and we will plan the installation with you.

Which water heater brands do you service?

We offer expert service for Racold water heaters. For any other brand, send us the brand and model and we will let you know.

My heater trips the breaker. Can I keep using it?

No. Switch it off at the mains and leave it off until it has been checked.

How often should a water heater be serviced?

Follow the interval in your manufacturer's manual. Homes with hard water usually need descaling more often.
